title: CART: Compatible Routing for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22137v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet real-world applications often require them to continually acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks, i.e., Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). In typical MLLMs, a projector is employed to align visual representations with the language model. However, existing methods primarily protect the language model from forgetting while continuously updating the projector across tasks. Such asymmetric adaptation can cause substantial representation drift in the projector, increasing the mismatch between the projector and language model and consequently exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To address this issue, we propose Compatible Routing (CART), which explicitly coordinates the adaptation of the projector and language model. Specifically, CART maintains task-specific experts for both modules and combines them through weighted mixt

translated_title: CART：面向多模态持续指令微调的兼容路由
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型通过指令微调获得了强大的性能，然而实际应用往往需要它们从序列任务中持续获取新能力，即多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）。在典型的多模态大语言模型中，投影器被用于将视觉表示与语言模型对齐。然而，现有方法主要注重保护语言模型免于遗忘，同时在各任务间持续更新投影器。这种不对称的适应方式会导致投影器产生严重的表示漂移，增大投影器与语言模型之间的失配，进而加剧灾难性遗忘。为解决这一问题，我们提出了兼容路由方法CART，显式地协调投影器与语言模型的适应过程。具体而言，CART为这两个模块均维护任务特定的专家，并通过加权混合的方式将它们组合起来。
tldr: 提出CART方法，通过为投影器和语言模型同时维护任务专家并进行加权混合的兼容路由，协调两个模块的适应过程，从而缓解多模态持续指令微调中的灾难性遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: CART mitigates catastrophic forgetting in multimodal continual instruction tuning by explicitly coordinating projector and language model adaptation through compatible routing with task-specific experts for both modules.
